description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different knowledge categories—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—across various large language models (LLMs) including Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT, as well as performance metrics based on accuracy and ground truth answers. The vertical axis represents popularity on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220, while the horizontal axis categorizes the data into the three domains. For each domain, there are multiple bars representing different models and answer types: Llama3 (blue with diagonal stripes), Qwen2 (red with crosshatch pattern), and ChatGPT (yellow with diagonal lines), along with two additional categories: "Acc=0 & GT Ans" (black with dots) and "Acc=1 & GT Ans" (white with black outline). In the Movies category, all models show relatively low popularity, with Llama3 having the highest value around 40, followed by Qwen2 at approximately 30, and ChatGPT at about 20. In the Songs category, popularity increases, with Llama3 reaching approximately 70, Qwen2 around 65, and ChatGPT around 60. The "Acc=0 & GT Ans" and "Acc=1 & GT Ans" bars are much shorter, indicating lower popularity in incorrect and correct answer cases, respectively. In the Basketball category, popularity peaks significantly, with Llama3 reaching about 180, Qwen2 surpassing 200, and ChatGPT around 170. The "Acc=0 & GT Ans" and "Acc=1 & GT Ans" bars remain low, with values around 10 and 20 respectively. The chart shows that Qwen2 generally has the highest popularity in correctly answered samples, particularly in Basketball, while Llama3 and ChatGPT show similar trends across domains. The visual data suggests that knowledge popularity varies significantly by domain and model, with Basketball being the most popular domain overall.
